description: Implement the complete backend: Lambda handlers for authentication, journal entries, and search with shared utilities. Also set up the project dependency files.
steps: Create src/requirements.txt with dependencies: boto3, bcrypt, pyjwt, python-ulid
Create src/utils/__init__.py and src/utils/auth.py with shared JWT verification (verify_token, get_jwt_secret using SSM Parameter Store, custom AuthError exception class)

Create src/handlers/auth.py implementing POST /auth/register and POST /auth/login. Register: validate username (3-20 chars, alphanumeric), validate password (min 8 chars), check user count < 10, check username uniqueness, hash with bcrypt, store in DynamoDB. Login: verify credentials, generate JWT with 24h expiry signed with SSM-stored secret.

Create src/handlers/entries.py implementing POST /entries (create entry with ULID id, validate content max 10000 chars) and GET /entries (list user's entries sorted newest first). Both require JWT auth.
Create src/handlers/search.py implementing GET /entries/search?q=query. Verify JWT, query user's entries, filter case-insensitive substring match on content, max query length 100 chars.
Ensure all handlers return consistent JSON responses with proper HTTP status codes (200, 201, 400, 401, 500) and error format {"error": "message"}
Handle API Gateway HTTP API event format (version 2.0) with routeKey-based routing within each handler
acceptance_criteria: src/handlers/auth.py exists with register and login logic
src/handlers/entries.py exists with create and list logic
src/utils/auth.py exists with verify_token and get_jwt_secret
All handlers use consistent error response format
JWT tokens include username claim and 24h expiry
verification: Run: python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src'); from handlers import auth, entries, search; from utils.auth import verify_token, get_jwt_secret; print('All imports successful')"
Run: python -m pytest tests/ -v (after tests are created in FEAT-003)
